title: Protect Your Pet’s Paws
description: Snow, ice, and road salt can irritate your pet’s paws. Use pet-safe paw balm or booties and wipe paws after outdoor walks.

title: Provide Warm Bedding
description: Ensure your pet has a warm, insulated sleeping area away from cold floors and drafts. Blankets and pet beds help maintain body heat.

title: Maintain Grooming Routine
description: Regular grooming keeps your pet’s coat healthy and helps prevent matting that can reduce insulation during winter.

title: Keep Pets Hydrated
description: Pets still need plenty of water in winter. Indoor heating can cause dehydration, so always provide fresh water.

title: Dress for the Weather
description: Short-haired or small pets may benefit from sweaters or coats when outdoors to stay warm and comfortable.

title: Limit Outdoor Exposure
description: Avoid long outdoor sessions during extreme cold. Watch for signs of shivering or discomfort and bring pets inside promptly.
